result.root_cause: uri_web/evaluate.py:19 _NUMBER is a single ad-hoc regex that only knows western 3-digit comma grouping (\d{1,3}(,\d{3})+) or bare digit runs, and captures no sign. findings.evidence: check_address('64:ff9b:1:a00:0:100:808:808') is allowed: the last 32 bits are 8.8.8.8.
